note: one bit a node, row-major from the SOUTH edge north, MSB first, each row padded to a byte. Set means LAND. Node (i, j) maps to `world` by linear interpolation.

source.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
source.dataset: San Francisco Bay, California Coastal Digital Elevation Model (san_francisco_13_mhw_2010)
source.what: the SIGN of an integrated bathymetric-topographic DEM on the Mean High Water datum. Not a published shoreline and not derived from one: land is where the surface is at or above the datum a chart draws its coast at.
source.reduced: every 1th node, taken in the pipeline. The consumer is a cut that refines 6 a side over 110.01 x 139.15 m cells, so its finest question is 18.33 x 23.19 m and this is just finer than that in both axes.
